MIT."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-search-chrome"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A free search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It drives **your lo"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"cal Chrome** through the `agent-browser` CLI — headless by default, with a persistent `--profile` di"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"rectory — and needs **no paid search API** and no API key."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- Provider id: `local-chrome` - Search engine: **Bing by default** (`engine: bing`), Google availabl"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e via `engine: google` (Google is frequently gated by IP-reputation anti-bot walls on VPN/datacenter"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" networks; Bing tolerates them far better — see docs/decisions-010.md §D7) - Model-facing `web_searc"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"h` tool: **zero changes** — switching the seam's `searchProvider` is a one-line patch. - Every resul"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"t carries `url` + `title` + `snippet` (+ best-effort `publishedAt`), exactly the shape `dsh-web` def"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ries `url` + `title` + `snippet` (+ best-effort `publishedAt`), exactly the shape `dsh-web` defines."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Privacy (read first):** search terms are sent to the search engine from your machine, enter t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"he **local Chrome profile's history**, and are subject to the engine's normal tracking. Searches run"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" in a **dedicated new tab that is closed when the search finishes**; your existing tabs are never to"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"uched. There is **no login state in 0.1** — a fresh, dedicated profile directory is used."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Per search: open a new labeled tab → wait for the DOM → extract the SERP → close the tab. Results are cached: in-session "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"(same query returns instantly) and on disk (JSON + TTL, default 24 h)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **Prereq: a DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) installation.** This is a dsh plugin — > it runs inside dsh's"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" `ctx.web` seam, so install dsh first if you have not: > `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` (or run i"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"t ad-hoc via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Two ways — pick one:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Manual** (§1–§3 below): explicit commands, good for pinning exact options. - **Automated via a d"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"sh agent** (§4): hand a task to a dsh agent; it installs everything and writes the patch with your r"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"eal paths (no placeholder edits)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 1.
